text: The lab results show elevated neutrophils, and the chest X-ray confirms alveolar infiltrates with air bronchograms in your left base. Given your productive cough with purulent sputum and these findings, do you currently have a fever or chills?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old male. The patient reports experiencing left-sided chest pain and a productive cough with purulent sputum for the past week. He mentions shortness of breath. States he was diagnosed with influenza recently but did not adhere to the treatment plan provided.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Left Lower Lobe)

The combination of purulent sputum, alveolar infiltrates with air bronchograms, and leukocytosis confirms the diagnosis. Given your recent influenza diagnosis and non-adherence to treatment, we will initiate appropriate antibiotic therapy immediately. Do you have any known allergies to penicillin or other antibiotics?
